skill.name: ecommerce-product-research
skill.description: Research ecommerce products and stores using TikTok and Facebook ads, product data, and store intelligence from PipiAds.
skill.summary: Compare products, ads, advertisers, and stores using PipiAds data.
skill.author: pipiads-dev

security_audit.summary: The shell alerts match Markdown labels, and most URL and key alerts match documentation or declarations. The configuration passes the API key to an external package that was not audited, and the separate domain for key issuance and billing is unverified. The workflow identifies credit costs but sets no spending limit.

remediation.issue: The MCP configuration passes the PipiAds API key to an external executable.
remediation.suggestion: Pass a dedicated, narrowly scoped key through the client secret store only after verifying the server package. Keep the key out of prompts and logs.

remediation.issue: The installer requests a global npm installation of a package outside the audited skill.
remediation.suggestion: Require approval before installation, verify the pinned package and its dependencies against trusted release metadata, and run the server in an isolated environment.

remediation.issue: Key issuance and billing use a different domain from the listed homepage.
remediation.suggestion: Link to key and billing settings from the verified PipiAds dashboard. Document why a separate domain is used if it is required.

remediation.issue: Search and follow-up requests can spend credits without a user-defined limit.
remediation.suggestion: Agree on a credit limit before querying, cap results, and request approval before exceeding the limit.

content.value_statement: Comparing products across ad platforms and stores takes time. Use PipiAds to compare ads, prices, offers, and competing storefronts in one research brief.
actual_capabilities: Search TikTok and Facebook ads for products in a target niche.
Look up ad details and product details for selected candidates.
Search ad library products and inspect their available details.
Find advertisers and stores associated with products in a niche.
Compare store competition, product coverage, and regional data where available.
Summarize pricing, offers, landing pages, and competitive density.
limitations: Live research requires a configured PipiAds MCP server and a valid API key.
Searches and detail lookups can consume credits from the connected account.
The workflow does not cover ongoing monitoring, organic TikTok content, or TikTok Shop analytics.
Ad activity can indicate where a product is promoted, but it does not prove sales or profitability.

use_cases.title: Shortlist Products for a Store
use_cases.description: Find advertised products in a target category and compare their prices and offers before choosing what to research further.

use_cases.title: Compare Paid Ad Offers
use_cases.description: Review TikTok and Facebook ads for a product and compare the offers and landing pages shown in the results.

use_cases.title: Map Store Competition
use_cases.description: Identify advertisers and storefronts in a niche, then compare their product overlap and regional coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Find Products in One Category
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to three pet travel products advertised on TikTok in the United States. Focus on products priced from $15 to $35. Ask for my credit budget first.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with one category, platform, and market.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Product Offers
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare up to three advertised desk organizers from $20 to $50 in Canada. Summarize pricing, offers, and landing-page details. Ask for my credit budget before searching or fetching details.
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare a small set of candidates before choosing one for deeper research.

prompt_templates.title: Check Activity Across Platforms
prompt_templates.prompt: Find ads for reusable lunch bags priced from $15 to $40 in the United Kingdom. Compare available TikTok and Facebook results by advertiser and offer. Confirm my credit budget first and flag missing evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Check whether the same niche appears on both ad platforms.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Competitor Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Research kitchen storage products from $25 to $60 in the United States across TikTok and Facebook. Compare up to three stores by product overlap, regions served, and pricing. Confirm a credit limit and separate observations from hypotheses.
prompt_templates.scenario: Combine ad, product, and store data in a market brief.

output_examples.input: Compare two hypothetical pet travel products advertised in the United States.
output: Collapsible bowl: $18 listed price. The TikTok ad shows a two-piece bundle.
Car seat cover: $32 listed price. The Facebook ad highlights washable fabric.
The ads show different offers. Neither result establishes sales volume.

output_examples.input: Summarize what a store comparison could show for desk organizers.
output: Illustrative store brief, not live data.
Store A emphasizes drawer dividers and bundle discounts.
Store B emphasizes cable trays and free shipping above a minimum order.
The stores overlap in category. Regional coverage is not available for Store B.

best_practices: Specify the category, price range, region, and platform before searching.
Agree on a credit budget, start with a small search, and request details only for shortlisted results.
Separate observed ads, prices, and offers from estimates of demand.
anti_patterns: Running broad searches or repeated detail lookups without a credit limit.
Treating frequent ads as proof of sales, profit, or customer demand.
Pasting the PipiAds API key into a prompt or research report.

faq.question: What do I need to run live research?
faq.answer: You need a configured PipiAds MCP server and a valid PipiAds API key. Verify the server package and set the key through your client.

faq.question: Which ad platforms can I compare?
faq.answer: You can compare TikTok and Facebook ads where PipiAds has data for your query.

faq.question: How are research credits charged?
faq.answer: The skill lists one credit per search result and one per detail request. It says repeat detail requests within three days are free.

faq.question: Can this skill monitor competitors continuously?
faq.answer: No. It is intended for focused research queries rather than ongoing monitoring.

faq.question: Does it cover organic TikTok or TikTok Shop analytics?
faq.answer: No. This workflow focuses on paid ads and related product, advertiser, and store data.

faq.question: Can ad activity tell me which product is most profitable?
faq.answer: No. Ad activity shows what sellers promote, but it does not establish revenue, costs, or profit.
